title: Security: POST /api/bot/devices/register takes no credential; devices DELETE/PATCH open when the token is unset
note: CODE READ 2026-11-11: src/web/api/routers/devices.py:200 has no auth check and writes device_tokens, so an outsider may be able to register a device and receive pushes. devices.py:75-76 returns open when DASHBOARD_API_TOKEN is unset (DELETE :333, PATCH :375, GET list :292). UNVERIFIED: whether the token is set on the VM and whether a registered stranger device actually receives FCM pushes. Also: prop.py:77 and devices.py:82 compare tokens with != (not constant-time). Fix: require a device session or the write token; fail closed when unset. Tier 2.
